name: valve_stairwell_a
note: an apartment stairwell, two storeys (a full turn) of the raid flats: wooden steps 60 wide (8 high, 12 deep) with wooden stringers climbing round an old lift shaft (wood panelled cage, metal mesh above, its shaft door and a Combine lock), landings, plaster walls, handrail clusters, a radiator, a bulb; the shaft's front is y 0, centred on x 0; 244 by 240, 258 high; stack it every 256. From Valve's d1_trainstation_03 (Source SDK sample)
